COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Building Consensus is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Building Consensus never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Building Consensus.
   C. Explain Building Consensus with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Building Consensus as rumours only.

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
